title: Adobe security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-202.031819: TT-CSIRT Advisory – Adobe Security Updates
leadParagraph: Adobe has released a security update stating that it has found a heap corruption issue(CVE-2019-7094) within Adobe Photoshop which could allow for arbitrary code execution.
contentHtml:
Adobe has released a security update stating that it has found a heap corruption issue(CVE-2019-7094) within Adobe Photoshop which could allow for arbitrary code execution.

Depending on the privileges associated with this application, an attacker could then install programs; view, change, or delete data; or create new accounts with full user rights. If this application has been configured to have fewer user rights on the system, exploitation of this vulnerability could have less impact than if it was configured with administrative rights.

Further information on this vulnerability and how it can be mitigated can be found on the Adobe Website at https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/photoshop/apsb19-15.html
